response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile web/full-stack engineer, but fits poorly with this embedded networking security role. He lacks the hard requirement of native-level Japanese, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, and no background in network switch development, security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), or embedded firmware. His only C experience is a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, falling well short of the strong C-for-UNIX proficiency required.
strengths: Extensive overall software development experience (15+ years) across multiple domains
Some low-level and performance experience (DLang low-latency systems, C/C++ at National Instruments)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — a hard requirement (native-level)
No Linux kernel, embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF)
C programming experience is minimal and dated; career is centered on web/TypeScript/Node.js
